standard.summary: Step Expert Routing 会按 denoise step 或 timestep 选择不同 LoRA 专家，适合 Turbo/few-step 学生路线。
standard.effect: 不同步数可走不同专家，提升 few-step 适配容量，但 adapter 需要 live routing，不能静态合并成普通 LoRA。
standard.whenToUse: 后续做 DP-DMD/Turbo 学生并有 checkpoint/save-load 路线时。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要可合并、可普通推理端加载的 LoRA；当前尚未注册训练入口。

standard_en.summary: Step Expert Routing picks a different LoRA expert according to the denoise step or timestep, which suits Turbo/few-step student routes.
standard_en.effect: Different step counts can go through different experts, which raises the few-step adaptation capacity, but the adapter then needs live routing and cannot be merged statically into an ordinary LoRA.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you later build a DP-DMD/Turbo student and have a checkpoint/save-load route.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need a LoRA that can be merged and loaded by an ordinary inference frontend; no training entry point is registered yet.

advanced.principle: 根据 step bucket/timestep 计算专家权重，再组合专家 LoRA delta。
advanced.intervention: Turbo denoise step context → live LoRA expert routing。
advanced.expectedImpact: 完整接入后可能改善 few-step 质量，但会增加 adapter 参数和推理端要求。
advanced.tradeoffs: 不适合作为普通 LoRA 默认格式。

advanced_en.principle: Computes expert weights per step bucket/timestep, then combines expert LoRA deltas.
advanced_en.intervention: Turbo denoise step context → live LoRA expert routing.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Once fully wired in, may improve few-step quality, but adds adapter parameters and inference-side requirements.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Not suitable as a default format for ordinary LoRAs.
